description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing various Git commands outside of a repository environment. It includes setup steps, command execution, and expectation checks for commands like git diff, git apply, git grep, and others, specifically in a non-repository context.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks their success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes given lines to a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within a file or output, similar to grep.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks if a command exits with the expected status code.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global git configuration variables used in the tests.
